name: @gavin-hu/my-pi-agent
description: Personal Pi customizations, packaged as a Pi package: worktree, ask-user-question, todo, goal, git, rewind, plan-mode, subagent, jobs, web-search, web-fetch, status-bar, and turn-separator.
author: Gavin Hu

scripts.transpile: bun build extensions/worktree/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-worktree-index.js && bun build extensions/ask-user-question/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-ask-user-question-index.js && bun build extensions/todo/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-todo-index.js && bun build extensions/goal/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-goal-index.js && bun build extensions/git/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-git-index.js && bun build extensions/rewind/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-rewind-index.js && bun build extensions/plan-mode/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-plan-mode-index.js && bun build extensions/subagent/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-subagent-index.js && bun build extensions/jobs/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-jobs-index.js && bun build extensions/web-search/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-web-search-index.js && bun build extensions/web-fetch/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-web-fetch-index.js && bun build extensions/status-bar/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-status-bar-index.js && bun build extensions/turn-separator/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-turn-separator-index.js
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run transpile && bun run test && bun run smoke && bun run e2e:rewind
